description: Call this when the user asks what a stock, index or commodity perpetual did over the weekend or overnight while the cash market was closed, how far it sat from the last cash close at each checkpoint, how the venues disagreed, and what gap the next open then realised. From ByKaranteli's own ten-minute venue record; window weekend or night; one symbol or the whole board.

symbol.description: One underlying, e.g. TSLA or XAU (default: the whole board)

window.description: weekend (Friday close to Monday open) or night (cash close to next open); default weekend

name: get_tradfi_gaps
title: Weekend and overnight gaps: stock, index and commodity perpetuals against the cash close, checkpoint by checkpoint
